0912Medicine

Multi-Agents for Clinical Decision Making

Space · Uddiii/Multi-Agentic

Act as an ER doctor: read history, question a simulated patient and nurse, order labs, document a diagnosis and discharge with a treatment.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • process-reward clinical RL
  • multi-agent medical simulation

Reward

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal
Dense, per step

Dense rule rewards for workflow, labs, diagnosis, plan, consent and emergency flag, plus 70B LLM judges for empathy and treatment (60/40 blend with a keyword verifier).

How to run it

1. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/Uddiii/Multi-Agentic
cd Multi-Agentic

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Groq API access for the judge and actor models.
